glossary.definition: Effective hydraulic energy per unit weight available across the turbine after subtracting intake, trash-rack, tunnel, and penstock friction losses from gross elevation head (Z_hw - Z_tw).
Operating discharge and head point where incoming water angle matches runner blade leading-edge angle cleanly with minimal exit swirl, maximizing hydraulic efficiency.
Annular ring of pivoting hydrofoil vanes surrounding a Francis runner that simultaneously throttle volumetric flow rate Q and adjust tangential swirl angle entering the runner.
Submerged expanding conduit beneath a reaction turbine runner that decelerates discharge flow, recovering kinetic velocity head as sub-atmospheric suction pressure beneath the runner.
Formation and violent collapse of vapor bubbles where local static pressure drops below water vapor pressure, or helical pressure-pulsation ropes formed in the draft tube at < 45-60% flow.
Acoustic pressure wave triggered by rapid flow velocity change in a closed conduit. A surge tank intercepts the pressure tunnel to absorb fluid momentum as safe open-surface oscillation.

Exact steady-state rotational speed dictated by interconnected grid frequency f and generator pole count N_p via n_s = 120f / N_p (250 rpm for 50 Hz, 24 poles). Load variations change torque, not steady-state RPM.
Controlled DC current fed to rotor field windings by the Automatic Voltage Regulator (AVR) to regulate stator terminal voltage and reactive power (MVAR) while speed stays grid-locked.
Boosting 11 kV generator output up to 132+ kV transmission voltage reduces line current proportionally and cuts resistive I^2R heat losses by (V_2 / V_1)^2.

equations.title: Gate Orifice Discharge Capacity
equations.variables: Q_cap,rated = 72.0 m³/s, H_rated = 85.0 m, u_gv in [0, 100] %
equations.notes: Orifice scaling restricts physically achievable flow when head drops or wicket gates partially close.

equations.title: Hydraulic Input Power
equations.variables: rho = 1000 kg/m³, g = 9.80665 m/s², Q in m³/s, H in m, P_h in W
equations.notes: Fundamental steady-state fluid power entering the turbine spiral casing.

equations.title: Turbine Mechanical Shaft Power & Torque
equations.variables: P_m in W (cap 58 MW), T in N·m, omega in rad/s (>= 0.5 rad/s guard)
equations.notes: At synchronous speed (250 rpm -> 26.18 rad/s), 45.93 MW produces ~1.754 MN·m of shaft torque.

equations.title: Synchronous Speed Relationship
equations.variables: f = 50 Hz (or 60 Hz), N_p = 24 poles -> n_s = 250.0 rpm
equations.notes: Grid-tied synchronous units remain speed-locked regardless of load changes.

equations.title: Generated & Grid-Delivered Electrical Power
equations.latex: P_e = \min(P_{e,\max},\ P_m \eta_g) = \rho g Q H \eta_t \eta_g, \qquad P_{\text{delivered}} = \min(P_e, P_{\text{load,req}})
equations.variables: P_e in W (cap 55 MW), eta_overall = P_e / P_h
equations.notes: Overall conversion efficiency equals the product eta_t * eta_g when unclamped.

assumptionsAndLimitations.title: Synthetic Educational Plant Baseline (denryu-hydro-unit-01)
assumptionsAndLimitations.detail: Nominal values (85.0 m rated net head, 60.0 m³/s flow, 50 MW mechanical rating, 24 poles, 50 Hz, 92% peak turbine efficiency, 97.5% peak generator efficiency) are illustrative educational parameters, not measured SCADA telemetry from an operating power station.

assumptionsAndLimitations.title: Smooth C1 Efficiency Curves vs. OEM Hill Charts
assumptionsAndLimitations.detail: Francis turbine and synchronous generator efficiency curves are documented smooth algebraic approximations reflecting part-load swirl/incidence drop and constant-plus-I²R electrical losses, rather than proprietary manufacturer model-test hill tables.

assumptionsAndLimitations.title: System-Level Steady/Quasi-Steady Model (No CFD, FEA, or MOC)
assumptionsAndLimitations.detail: DENRYU does not solve 3D Navier-Stokes CFD meshes, structural finite-element stresses, or Method-of-Characteristics (MOC) elastic water-hammer PDEs. Net Head (H) represents effective turbine inlet head after conveyance friction losses.

assumptionsAndLimitations.title: Conceptual Modular 3D Geometry
assumptionsAndLimitations.detail: The 3D facility and double-curved 15-blade Francis runner are engineered procedural educational representations calibrated to 1 unit = 1 meter conventions rather than manufacturer fabrication CAD.
